may 1 Notes:


I took a winning trade for the day and it was off of a 5min rejection block. I was thinking I would get a 10:00 setup today, but it never played out.
,
At market open, price rallied all the way until 10:00 which we saw consolidation and then a retracement afterwards. We did not see a move all the way down into discount, but into a 15m and 30m discounted fvg. From there we had a 5min fvg (bearish candle followed by bullish) and it was a really big wick so I was looking to enter off of the ce, and we had consolidated above it generating some el on the 1min time frame. and by the time nq reached ce, es took the low and made an smt further confirming our trade. I targeted all time highs because there were equal highs there and the trade hit full profit for a 1:7 (Screenshots 1 & 2)
,
The rest of the day was mostly consolidation, but this was a good trade that eliminated all of my losses in april and put me at a new high in my eval.

Today I took two trades and they were both losers, and they were honestly both pretty bad trades, but I took them because I am trying to up my trade frequency.
,

I waited until 10:00 and at that point we made even more stacked lows, but I didn’t think we would take them so I took a 5min rb that formed with 10:00, but we wnt straight into consolidation. The thing with this trade is that if I entered off of ce then I could have put my stop at the low and taken a win, so the lesson learned is always cover the low because the rejection block held. It was a bearish candle that got confirmed by the next bullish one. That is unfortunate that it could have been a winner. (Screenshot 1)
,
This next trade was a little less intelligent because once we started to consolidate I thought we might get an amd model. So I waited for one side to get taken and when the top got taken we entered a 5min fvg and formed a 5min rb so I entered and got stopped out instantly. I should have been a little more patient here because we didn’t really trade out of the range, but my conviction was the stacked equal lows. (Screenshot 2)
,
There were three other trades I could have taken today, the first was limiting the ce and covering the low. That is 100% a lesson learned and won’t make that mistake again. The second was a 1min powell model. The 10:00 manipuation move had a 1min rb at the bottom  and formed el above the ce. This trade would have been a minimal drawdown entry and very good rr.
